general.title: Asian Stocks Drop as AI Worries Offset State Support Measures
general.summary: South Korean and Chinese shares fell, showing investor sentiment toward the AI trade remains fragile even after Asian authorities rolled out support measures and US markets showed signs of stabilizing.
